title: Kuedzwa kweMweya Unoramba Uchienderera Mberi
intro: Mweya unomira panguva yekuedzwa kwaMwari, uchitsvaga nhungamiro nekuzvininipisa. Iye anoziva zvese anodzinga munhu uyu anotsvaga, ozozozivisa gare gare kuti uyu waiva muedzo wemoyo. Kuburikidza nekutaurirana uku kusinganzwisisike, chidzidzo pamusoro peuchenjeri hwaMwari chinozarurwa pamberi peavo vanofungisisa. Unogona here kuona munhu uyu kubva munyaya yeKorani?
clues: Ndakatsvaga ruzivo nenhungamiro kubva kumutumwa waAllah anodiwa
Ndakauya ndichitsvaga chokwadi, ndichishevedza Muporofita nechido chechokwadi
Ndakatsiurwa ndikadzoserwa shure, nekuti huchenjeri hwaAllah hwaive nedzimwe hurongwa panguva iyoyo
Asi handina kuora mwoyo—panzvimbo pezvo, ndakaenderera mberi nekutsvaga kwangu
Iye anoziva zvese akataura kuti izvi zvaive kuyedzwa kwemoyo uye yambiro
Ndaive mumwe weavo Korani inozivisa nezvavo kuti: 'Akafinyamisa chiso ndokutendeuka, nekuti bofu rakauya kwaari'
